1.title: What is Saving?
1.text: **Saving** means keeping some of your money for later instead of spending it all now. When you save, you put money aside for something you want in the future, like a **goal**!

2.title: Why Save Money?
2.text: Saving helps you buy things you really want! It's like filling up a piggy bank. The more you **save**, the closer you get to your **goal**.

3.title: Setting a Goal
3.text: A **goal** is something you're saving for. It could be a toy, a game, or even a special trip! Having a goal makes saving more fun.

4.title: Patience Pays Off
4.text: Sometimes you have to wait to buy what you want. That's called being **patient**. When you're patient and keep saving, you'll reach your goal!

5.title: Celebrate Your Savings!
5.text: When you finally save enough, you can buy your goal! That feeling of **accomplishment** is amazing. You did it by being smart with your money!

1.title: What is Spending?
1.text: **Spending** means using your money to buy things. Every time you buy something, you **spend** money. It's important to think before you spend!

2.title: Needs vs Wants
2.text: A **need** is something you must have, like food. A **want** is something nice to have, like candy. Learning the difference helps you spend wisely!

3.title: Smart Spending
3.text: **Smart spending** means thinking about whether you really need something before buying it. Ask yourself: Do I need this or just want it?

4.title: Making Good Choices
4.text: Every time you spend, you make a **choice**. Good choices help you save money for things that matter most to you!

5.title: Spending and Saving Balance
5.text: It's okay to spend money on things you enjoy! The trick is finding a **balance** between spending and saving.

1.title: What is Money Management?
1.text: **Money management** means making a plan for your money. It helps you decide how much to save and how much to spend!

2.title: Making a Budget
2.text: A **budget** is a plan that shows how you'll use your money. It helps you keep track of what you earn, save, and spend.

3.title: Tracking Your Money
3.text: **Tracking** means keeping count of your money. When you know how much you have, you can make better choices!

4.title: Earning Money
4.text: **Earning** means getting money for doing something, like chores. The money you earn is called **income**.

5.title: Being Money Smart
5.text: When you manage your money well, you're being **responsible**! This means you're making good choices about saving, spending, and earning.
